scope: QA-only static decoder prototype and pinned read-only review of later P1 optimizations; no runtime adapter, product build or deployment.

findings.change: Parallel watch eligibility and embed configuration bootstrap
findings.portable: Promise-level overlap is portable only after both browser requests are readable. It does not change CORS or grant access.

findings.change: Speculative player POST overlaps AST preparation using a literal ST hint
findings.portable: Native accepts its response only if full AST extraction independently returns that exact ST. A pre-extracted static recipe already removes mobile AST preparation, so this overlap adds little to that design.

Useful identity pattern: source URL + fresh source SHA + analyzer/runtime ABI + script checksum + six-hour local TTL, capped at four entries/eight MiB. Actual new cache lookup still downloads base.js before trusting a saved decoder. With browser GET blocked, a PWA cannot claim that fresh-source validation; static recipe provenance/freshness must be a separate, explicitly bounded policy.

findings.change: QuickJS release C optimization and app-local file initialization
findings.portable: Rust/QuickJS/native filesystem specifics, not a web adapter. Decoder transform itself did not change in this commit; youtube_decoder.rs changes add an ignored profiling test.

browserDesignAssessment.proposal: Dedicated worker within an opaque sandbox iframe; connect-src none; narrowly bounded script/worker sources; network/import entrypoints constrained; trusted wrapper verifies protocol and terminates externally on deadline.
limits: Opaque origin isolates application storage but does not alone disable worker networking or code imports.
connect-src none does not itself establish the importScripts/dynamic-import policy; worker script-src and import entrypoints require independent proof.
Browser termination controls time but offers no equivalent hard QuickJS memory quota.
Build-time AST extraction avoids the native 192 MiB preparation step on the phone, while signature/n execution still needs isolation and bounded inputs.
No browser execution of this provider fragment, fresh-visitor generic configuration, made-for-kids JSON eligibility, CDN bytes or playback has been established by this prototype.

decision: Static decoder generation is established for this public player hash. Activating a generic runtime recipe remains gated on independent browser bootstrap/context and complete media validation.
